newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise May rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise May rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday that it was raising the margin requirement on the May rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The increase will bring the total May rubber futures requirement to 80,000 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The move is intended to cool overheated trade.
The margin for the April contract will remain unchanged at 106,000 yen, while the requirement on other contracts will stay at 60,000 yen, TOCOM said.
